B_historical_EURUSD.driver: this script (rolling host windows D1 30 / H1 200 / M5 300, cadence = every M5 close)
B_historical_EURUSD.note: state = the shipped snapshot (detection + the 2026-10-10 delivery gate); signal_state = detection only. Off-host the delivery gate rejects every detected opportunity: REJECT_NO_STOP / REJECT_NO_TARGET where C10 or C11 legitimately produced no level, and REJECT_STALE for the fully-costed ones, because the owner remaining-reward threshold config/local/actionability_policy.yaml is host-only and has no fallback (watch._remaining_fraction). REJECT_STALE counts are therefore an environment fact, not a rule failure.

BTCUSD.scope: first N full-D1-window scans (the C16 headline scope)

committed_verdict_reasons: L5 WARN (OD1011-L5: no stop distance, commission unbound off-host, no cost gate)
stop geometry NOT_APPLICABLE: C10_PIP_SIZE_NOT_EVIDENCED for BTCUSD

coverage_derived_from_artifact.headline_in_artifact: gate_status_counts L1-L4 + L6 = PASS on every full-D1 scan
coverage_derived_from_artifact.reading: A gate status of PASS counts the gate, not the checks inside it. On this 60-day replay L2's six opportunity rules were evaluable on 2040 of 8961 full-D1 scans, and L3.stop_side / L3.stop_beyond_sweep on 0 of them (with_c10_stop = 0, C10_PIP_SIZE_NOT_EVIDENCED). The committed NOT_VERIFIED verdict already says the second half; this makes the first half explicit.

fixture_provenance.scenario: Distinct BTCUSDT-only deterministic CHoCH fixture; synthetic external buy-side level remains unswept.
Distinct ETHUSDT-only deterministic CHoCH fixture; synthetic external buy-side level remains unswept.

fixture_provenance.notes: D1/H1/M5 are all copied from one owner-provided VT MT5 EURUSD-VIP snapshot (true-UTC labels, server UTC+3), source commit data/eurusd-d1-mt5@a44437e, SHA256 ff77c9338f6fcc74079cf88d69d103b0c5e4e5a19856b6d4dce8a28333e5701e. H1-rebuilt D1 equals MT5 D1 on 48/48 complete source days; snapshot's single partial edge at 2026-08-19 21:00Z is excluded from the full comparison; Sunday-open and Friday-close partial buckets are listed and never filled. The old fixture (SHA a8bf11a9…2323d1) differed from current broker history: D1 extremes shifted 1-3 points on 7/30 days and H1 changed on 35/120 bars; this is broker history revision, not a logic defect. Snapshot contains 4 additional M5 bars (604 vs 600).
Captured H1 may be used only as context; it has no decision-window overlap. Synthetic D1/M5 are logic probes and are not paired as host market history.
